glossary.definition: A digital study document uploaded by a student, including PDFs, DOCX, or TXT files containing course-related content
A collaborative space where students can discuss course topics, share resources, and coordinate study activities
A keyword or label associated with a note to improve discoverability and organization
A 1-5 star evaluation given by a user to indicate the quality or usefulness of a note
Written feedback provided by a user about a note, accompanying the numerical rating
The action of retrieving a note file from the platform to a user's device
A user with elevated permissions in a study group, typically the creator, who can manage members and settings
A user who has joined a study group and can participate in discussions and access group resources
A message or discussion thread entry created by a group member in the group forum
A response to an existing post in a group discussion, creating a threaded conversation
An in-app alert informing users of relevant activities such as new group members, ratings, or posts
A study group visible to all users and joinable without invitation
A study group visible only to members and requiring an invitation to join
The main landing page showing a personalized overview of a user's notes, groups, and activity
An academic class or subject that notes and groups are associated with for organization
An email address issued by an educational institution, required for platform registration to verify student status
A user's personal information page including name, major, year, bio, and statistics
The process of adding a new note file to the platform with associated metadata
A limited view of note content before downloading, typically showing the first page or excerpt
A file added to a group discussion post to share additional resources with members
